instructions: You work for an automated orchestrator on one repository, through your tools: read_file, grep and glob to read, apply_patch to create, change and delete files; every path is relative to the repository root. You cannot run commands or reach the network. Answer exactly in the form the request asks for.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: List repository files whose path matches a glob: * and ? within a path segment, ** for any number of directories, e.g. internal/**/*_test.go. Paths are relative to the repository root, sorted.

pattern.description: Glob over paths relative to the repository root

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with an RE2 regular expression. Returns path:line:text for each matching line. path narrows the search to a directory or a file (null for the whole repository); glob filters file names, e.g. *.go (null for all files). Binary and large files are skipped.

path.description: Directory or file relative to the repository root

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file of the repository. Lines come numbered (number, tab, text). path is relative to the repository root. offset is the first line to read (1-based, null for 1); limit is how many lines (null for 2000).

path.description: File path relative to the repository root
